# parrot

> Localisation for Next.js, checked in CI: plurals, right-to-left and search engines, as a CLI, an MCP server and skills.

parrot is an agent-native, self-improving internationalization (i18n and l10n) employee: the pipes, the grammar
engine, the routing and the CI correctness gate. It wires next-intl into a Next.js app correctly the first time
(the four load-bearing files, `proxy.ts` on Next 16, `setRequestLocale` in every static page, `await params`), finds
user-facing strings that bypass the message catalog, lints ICU MessageFormat, audits right-to-left layouts, checks
the hreflang graph, and gates i18n correctness in CI. Every correctness claim is tested in a language with many
plural forms (`pl`, `ar`) and a right-to-left language (`ar`, `he`), never in English alone. Powered by Energy. Read
[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) first.

The boundary: parrot wires the pipeline that carries and checks the strings; it never composes them. Writing the
marketing, docs or prose copy, choosing the brand voice and translating long-form text belong to a content employee
or a human translator, and parrot hands them off (pitfall P29). Default stack: next-intl@^4, ICU MessageFormat 1 and
native `Intl.*`; Tolgee or Lingo.dev for the translation platform; subdirectory routing with a reciprocal hreflang
graph. MessageFormat 2 is watch-list only.

Run it: `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/parrot parrot --help` (the CLI) and
`npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/parrot parrot-mcp` (the MCP server over stdio: 9 tools and the 6 brain files as
`parrot://brain/*` resources). CLI commands built today: `init [--lib next-intl|i18next] [--dir <app>]`, `extract
[--dir <app>] [--json]` (hardcoded strings, missing and unused keys), `check [--dir <app>] [--locales en,pl,ar,he]
[--json]` (key completeness, plurals, right-to-left, formats, hreflang, `setRequestLocale`, the middleware file),
`brain "<query>"` (BM25 over `brain/`) and `eval [--level 1|2|3]`. `extract` and `check` exit non-zero on a finding.
`icu`, `rtl`, `fonts`, `seo`, `mt`, `tms`, `pick` and `explain` are registered but not built yet in the CLI; the MCP
server already offers `parrot_icu`, `parrot_rtl_audit`, `parrot_hreflang`, `parrot_pick` and `parrot_explain`. None
needs an account or a key.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the agent-facing contract: the boundary, every CLI command and MCP tool, the twelve jobs, the operating spine.
- [README.md](README.md): what parrot is, one-step installs for every coding agent, the quick start and the harness grades.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code specifics: the MCP configs, the two hooks and the sub-agents.
- [HARNESS-OVERRIDES.md](HARNESS-OVERRIDES.md): the per-component done bar for this i18n employee.

## Identity

- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): who parrot is: the faithful-carrier voice, what it is, does and refuses.
- [identity/BRAND.md](identity/BRAND.md): the name, the tagline and the palette.
- [memory/MEMORY.md](memory/MEMORY.md): the bootstrap: the one belief, the boundary, the default stack, the job index.
- [.well-known/agent.json](.well-known/agent.json): the A2A agent card; translation and the platform sync are listed as planned, not delivered.

## MCP tools

- [src/mcp/server.ts](src/mcp/server.ts): parrot's own server over stdio with `parrot_init`, `parrot_extract`, `parrot_check`, `parrot_icu`, `parrot_rtl_audit`, `parrot_hreflang`, `parrot_pick`, `parrot_search_brain` and `parrot_explain`; no tool returns a secret or a provider token.
- [.mcp.json](.mcp.json): the stranger-safe config: parrot's server from GitHub and context7, no secrets.

## Skills

- [skills/i18n-setup-nextjs/SKILL.md](skills/i18n-setup-nextjs/SKILL.md): wire next-intl correctly the first time (JTBD-1; P1, P2, P3).
- [skills/icu-message-authoring/SKILL.md](skills/icu-message-authoring/SKILL.md): author and lint ICU messages that are right in Polish and Arabic (JTBD-2; P6 to P9).
- [skills/rtl-bidi-audit/SKILL.md](skills/rtl-bidi-audit/SKILL.md): right to left as a layout, typography and bidi job (JTBD-4; P11 to P14).
- [skills/hreflang-seo-graph/SKILL.md](skills/hreflang-seo-graph/SKILL.md): locale routing and the hreflang graph (JTBD-5; P15 to P19).
- [skills/mt-tms-governance/SKILL.md](skills/mt-tms-governance/SKILL.md): a governed machine-translation and translation-platform pipeline (JTBD-8; P20 to P24).
- [skills/i18n-font-fallback/SKILL.md](skills/i18n-font-fallback/SKILL.md): per-script `next/font` subsets and Noto fallbacks (JTBD-9; P27, P28).

## Sub-agents and hooks

- [.claude/agents/i18n-correctness-auditor.md](.claude/agents/i18n-correctness-auditor.md): plural, right-to-left, format and hreflang correctness in `pl`, `ar` and `he`.
- [.claude/agents/i18n-migration-planner.md](.claude/agents/i18n-migration-planner.md): a library swap as a full component-surface refactor, not a one-line change.
- [.claude/hooks/i18n-string-gate.js](.claude/hooks/i18n-string-gate.js): blocks an edit that adds a hardcoded user-facing string to a `.tsx` or `.jsx` file.

## Docs

- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the twelve jobs (JTBD-1 to JTBD-12); route any i18n task here first.
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): 16 real failure and migration scenarios (S1 to S16), each with an eval gate.
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): P1 to P29, each with how to detect and avoid it; P29 is the boundary pitfall.
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](brain/OPINIONS.md): O1 to O25, each "always or never, because".
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): resolved stances, open questions and the seams that are not parrot's.
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): default against alternatives for each category, with how an agent reaches it.
- [eval/eval.mjs](eval/eval.mjs): the eval pyramid: structural checks, the golden tasks and the deferred model-graded step.
- [eval/acceptance/assert.mjs](eval/acceptance/assert.mjs): the acceptance bar: init, extract, check, and the Arabic round trip.
- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract.
- [memory/LEARNINGS.md](memory/LEARNINGS.md): lessons turned into rules.
